title: This Company Owns More Nvidia Than Jensen Huang
desc:
Jensen Huang owns about 3.5% of Nvidia. BlackRock owns about 8%, and 7-8% of Apple and Microsoft too. It never designed a single chip.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: It Manages More Money Than India, Japan and France Produce
desc:
By mid-2026 BlackRock managed $15.3 trillion of other people's money. It makes nothing. So how does it own a piece of everything?
Full story on our YouTube channel.

title: Wall Street Turned Your Home Loan Into a Bond
desc:
A bank waits up to 30 years to get its money back. Wall Street found a faster way: pool the loans and sell them as bonds. Here's how it works.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: The A-B-C Trick That Made Money Out of Nothing
desc:
$100 million of home loans, sliced into A, B and C. Each slice gets paid in order, and the gap between what homeowners pay and what bonds pay is the profit.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Why Paying Your Loan Off Early Cost Wall Street Millions
desc:
A family with a $200,000 loan at 9% refinances at 7% and walks out. For whoever owned that old loan, 30 years of interest just disappears.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.

title: The Star Trader Who Lost $100 Million
desc:
Larry Fink was Wall Street's star bond trader. Then rates fell, homeowners paid back early, and his desk lost about $100 million. That loss is how BlackRock began.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: The Software Watching Over Trillions of Dollars
desc:
BlackRock built a machine to ask 'what if?' about every holding. They called it Aladdin, and today it helps watch trillions, much of it not BlackRock's own.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: In 2008, Washington Called One Firm to Clean Up
desc:
When the banks blew up, the Federal Reserve and the Treasury brought in BlackRock to value and manage the toxic assets of Bear Stearns and AIG.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

title: The $13.5 Billion Deal That Changed Investing
desc:
In 2009, with Wall Street on its knees, BlackRock bought Barclays Global Investors and iShares. Overnight it went from about $1.3 trillion to over $3 trillion.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: 9 in 10 Fund Managers Lose to the Market
desc:
Over 15 years, around nine in ten large US stock funds did worse than the S&P 500. You paid their fees anyway. So why not just buy the index?
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: What Is an ETF? The Simplest Explanation
desc:
An index fund copies a list like the S&P 500. Put in $10,000 and a program splits it by weight. No stock picking, and a tiny fee.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: A Tiny Fee on Trillions Is a Huge Business
desc:
BlackRock's main S&P 500 ETF charges about 0.03% a year. On more than six trillion dollars in iShares, running every day, that adds up fast.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

title: Nobody at BlackRock Chose to Buy Nvidia
desc:
Every dollar in an index fund buys a slice of every company in the index. That's how BlackRock holds 7-8% of Nvidia without anyone picking it.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Meet the Big Three: The Quiet Owners of America
desc:
BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street. Together they're the largest shareholder in about nine out of ten S&P 500 companies, and shareholders get votes.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Texas Sued BlackRock Over Coal. Here's Why
desc:
In late 2024 Texas and ten other states sued the Big Three, claiming they used their stakes to cut coal output. The firms deny it. Vanguard settled in 2026.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.
